introHtml: Carhartt pants and shorts are built for the toughest job sites, with reinforced seams and durable fabrics that withstand daily wear. When you add your logo through screen printing or embroidery, these work-ready garments become a uniform your team will actually want to wear. Safety managers and HR directors choose Carhartt for its reputation in construction, warehousing, and outdoor industries. Bulk orders ensure consistent branding across crews of any size.
